HatchPattern__MixedWoodland__Meta.Meta__Description: Mixed woodland - conifer and broadleaf tree glyphs scattered on a repeating tile, in the Ordnance Survey manner. Drawn as an AREA texture, not as individual surveyed canopies: it says 'this is woodland', it does not say where each tree is.
HatchPattern__MixedWoodland__Meta.Meta__WhyTransparent: The tile paints GLYPHS ONLY and never a background. The solid green wash under it is the fill deck of the site plan composite, which is a separate layer with its own colour and opacity. Baking a ground into the tile would collapse two of the three decks into one and make the wash impossible to switch off on its own.
HatchPattern__MixedWoodland__Meta.Meta__WhyPaperUnits: Every length here is PAPER millimetres, like the dash patterns in Na__LayoutEditor__EdgeStyles__Config__.json. A tree therefore measures the same on the sheet at 1:200 and at 1:500, which is what a drawn symbol does - the drawing gets denser as the scale coarsens, exactly as an OS sheet does. Pattern__Scale on a viewport adjusts from there.
HatchPattern__MixedWoodland__Meta.Meta__WhyGlyphOrigin: A glyph is drawn about its own BASE CENTRE, x to the right and y DOWN, so it can be placed by the point it appears to stand on. That matches the sheet's own coordinate sense and makes a tile easy to author by hand.
HatchPattern__MixedWoodland__Meta.Meta__WhyEightGlyphs: Eight glyphs on an 18 mm tile reads as woodland without the repeat becoming obvious. Fewer looks sparse and the grid shows; many more turns to mush at 1:500. The positions are hand-placed rather than generated, so the pattern is identical on screen and on paper and cannot drift between renders.

HatchPattern__MixedWoodland__Identity.Identity__Description: How this pattern is named, found and grouped in the Patterns panel.
HatchPattern__MixedWoodland__Identity.Identity__Note: Referenced by 75__SitePlan__SoftLandscape__Trees__MixedWoodland in the Tags SSOT, through SitePlan__FillHatchId.

HatchPattern__MixedWoodland__Tile.Tile__Description: The repeating cell, in paper millimetres. RowOffsetMm shifts every other row sideways so the repeat does not read as a grid.
HatchPattern__MixedWoodland__Tile.Tile__Note: The glyph positions already stagger, so no row offset is needed here.

HatchPattern__MixedWoodland__Defaults.Defaults__Description: What the pattern draws with before a viewport overrides anything. A stroke colour of 'inherit' takes the layer's own line colour, so the woodland hatch is green because the woodland layer is green.

HatchPattern__MixedWoodland__Glyphs.Glyphs__Description: Reusable shapes, each drawn about its base centre with y pointing DOWN. Path data is ordinary SVG, in tile millimetres.

Conifer.Glyph__Note: A fir: a vertical stem with three chevron tiers widening downward.

Broadleaf.Glyph__Note: A short stem under a rounded crown. Unfilled, so the wash below shows through, as the OS sheet draws it.

HatchPattern__MixedWoodland__Placements.Place__Note: Straddles the bottom edge, so it knits to the tile below
Straddles the right edge: its arms reach 0.55 mm past it

Its other half, one tile to the left, so the two meet exactly across the seam. Without it the browser clipped the three right-hand arms of this conifer in every wood, while the PDF printed them whole (21-Sep-2026)

HatchPattern__MixedWoodland__Bounds.Bounds__Description: How far a viewport may scale and turn this pattern before it stops reading as woodland.
